characters.name: Tove Marka
characters.description: A seed-keeper of the vault caravan, raised on the routes, who grades grain by eye and counts winters like coin.
characters.motivation: To see the seedways whole again before she hands on her satchel.
characters.goal: Reach Ford Market with sound stock before the last frost.
characters.flaw: She carries the whole route alone and will not be helped.
characters.internal_conflict: Mending the split means trusting the people who broke it.
characters.external_conflict: The cut tithe grain makes every town suspect her caravan.

abilities.name: Seed-scoring
abilities.description: Judges germination and adulteration in a sack of grain by eye and weight.

characters.arc: Tove learns that a route no one else can walk is a route that dies with her.

characters.name: Alder Vane
characters.description: The compact factor at Ford Market who diluted the tithe grain to keep his town's mill turning through a hard year.
characters.motivation: To protect his town from an audit that would starve it.
characters.goal: Conceal the diluted tithe until after the thaw audit.
characters.flaw: He believes a debt concealed is a debt half-paid.
characters.internal_conflict: He knows the orchard families paid for his town's lie.
characters.external_conflict: Tove's inspection can read the chaff in his sacks.

abilities.name: Weigh-house politics
abilities.description: Reads markets, credit and debtors well enough to move a ledger without leaving fingerprints.

characters.arc: Vane must confess the cut grain or watch the routes close around him.

characters.name: Nuna Brack
characters.description: An orchard daughter who grafts blight-hardy stock and carries her family's claim to the promised grain.
characters.motivation: To win the grafting stock her family's orchard was promised.
characters.goal: Make the caravan honour the orchard claims before the frost.
characters.flaw: She presses her claim so hard it sounds like a threat.
characters.internal_conflict: She distrusts every keeper yet needs this caravan.
characters.external_conflict: The caravan and the millers both call her claim premature.

abilities.name: Graft-keeping
abilities.description: Keeps grafted stock alive through cold snaps and rough travel.

characters.arc: Nuna wins her stock by helping the caravan prove the fraud that cheated it.

relationships.description: Nuna rides with the caravan to press the orchard claim.
relationships.conflict: Tove cannot honour the claim until the tithe fraud is proven.

relationships.description: Tove's seed-scoring can expose Vane's diluted tithe.
relationships.conflict: Vane must stall her inspection past the frost.
